minor.issue: Endpoint persists history_disabled to users collection, but get_current_user must include that field for subsequent POST /me/search-history to short-circuit. Verified: works end-to-end (test_history_disabled_skips passes), but worth ensuring auth dependency always projects history_disabled.
obtained_count is computed globally (count of applications in OBTAINED_STATUSES) — not filtered by the days window. Document or scope-by-window for consistency with the 'window_days' label.

Idempotency key uses siret if provided, else name. Two different companies with the same plain name (no SIRET) added by the same student would be silently de-duplicated. Consider falling back to (name, city) or (name, postal_code) when siret is absent.

issues: The 'Email contact' input has no data-testid (placeholder-only); fine for now but consider mc-email-{id} for parity with mc-date / mc-note.
Uses native browser <input type='date'> (mm/dd/yyyy). System prompt prefers shadcn Calendar component for date pickers — minor UX inconsistency with the rest of the app.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py = 3656 lines (was 3345 in Phase B). Phase C+D+E added ~310 lines and pushes the file far beyond the 700-line rule. STRONG recommendation to split into backend/routers/lists.py, ai.py, admin.py and mount under phase_api.
Phase C exports import openpyxl and reportlab modules INSIDE the handler. For PDF/XLSX exports of small lists this is fine (small overhead), but consider top-level imports if the file is split.

Phase D /ai/search: criteria parsing uses a greedy regex on the LLM raw output. If the LLM returns JSON with leading prose, parsing still works, but malformed JSON silently becomes {} (no warning logged). Add a logger.warning for visibility.

Phase D /me/search-history POST returns {ok:true, skipped:true} when history_disabled=True — but other endpoints in this router return inserted-doc structure. Frontend must check 'skipped' before assuming an id is present.

Phase E /admin/api-stats: aggregations match on $query.q / $query.departement / $query.activite_principale assuming api_request_logs has a sub-document 'query'. Confirm the logger that writes these documents always stores the full querystring under 'query'.

MyCompaniesPage.jsx: every keystroke in note/email/relance_date inputs fires a PATCH (via onChange → update). On a slow connection this could spam the API. Consider a 500ms debounce before calling update().

AISearchBar usage relies on call_ai. Loading state during AI extraction does not have a visible skeleton in OffersPage/CompanyDirectoryPage — the bar shows busy text but the page below appears unchanged for up to 10s. Consider a subtle linear loader for clarity.
